reading.title: Bioluminescence in Deep-Sea Organisms
reading.passage: Bioluminescence is the production of light by living organisms through chemical reactions. In the deep ocean, where sunlight cannot penetrate, many creatures have evolved this remarkable ability. Fish, jellyfish, and squid use bioluminescent light for various purposes, including hunting prey, attracting mates, and communicating with other members of their species. The light-producing organs, called photophores, contain specialized cells that generate light through the oxidation of luciferin. Scientists estimate that approximately 90% of deep-sea creatures produce or display bioluminescence, making it one of the most common adaptations in the ocean.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is the primary function of bioluminescence in deep-sea organisms?
options: To hunt prey, attract mates, and communicate
questions.explanation: 지문에서 생물이 빛을 사냥, 짝짓기 유인, 의사소통 등의 목적으로 사용한다고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What does the term 'photophores' refer to?
options: The chemical substance that produces light
The deepest part of the ocean
questions.explanation: 지문에서 photophores는 '빛을 생성하는 기관'으로 정의되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What percentage of deep-sea creatures are estimated to use bioluminescence?
questions.explanation: 지문의 마지막 문장에서 심해 생물의 약 90%가 생물발광을 생성하거나 표시한다고 명시되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Remote work is more productive than working in an office environment'? Support your answer with specific examples.

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 제시: 동의하는지 반대하는지 명확히 표현하고, 간단한 이유 2-3가지를 미리 언급합니다.
structure.body1: 첫 번째 주장: 원격근무의 장점 (집중력, 통근시간 절약 등) 또는 사무실 근무의 장점 (협업, 직접 커뮤니케이션 등)을 구체적인 예시와 함께 설명합니다.
structure.body2: 두 번째 주장: 다른 관점의 장점을 또 다른 구체적 예시와 함께 제시합니다. 첫 번째 주장의 반대편 의견도 인정하되, 왜 본인의 의견이 더 타당한지 설명합니다.
structure.conclusion: 서론에서 제시한 입장을 다시 강조하고, 두 가지 주요 근거를 요약한 후 마무리합니다.

그러나 인간 교사는 감정적 지원, 도덕적 교육, 창의적 사고 발달 등을 제공하며 AI는 이를 완전히 대체할 수 없다는 점

listening.title: Campus Library Study Room Reservation
listening.script: Student: Hi, I'd like to book a study room in the library for tomorrow afternoon. Librarian: Of course! We have several options available. How many hours do you need? Student: I'm thinking about three hours, probably from 2 PM to 5 PM. Librarian: Let me check our system. Yes, that time slot is available. How many people will be using the room? Student: Just me and my study partner, so two people. Librarian: Perfect. The rooms accommodate up to six people. I should mention that all study rooms are equipped with a whiteboard, projector, and computer access. However, food and drinks other than water are not permitted inside. Student: That's helpful to know. What's the cancellation policy? Librarian: You can cancel up to 24 hours before your reservation without any penalty. After that, you'll be charged a $5 cancellation fee. Student: Understood. Let's proceed with the reservation.

questions.q: What time does the student want to reserve the study room?
questions.explanation: 대화에서 학생이 '2시부터 5시까지, 3시간' 동안 예약하길 원한다고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: How many people will use the study room?
questions.explanation: 학생이 '나와 공부 파트너, 2명'이 사용할 것이라고 말했습니다.

questions.q: What items are NOT allowed in the study room?
questions.explanation: 사서가 '물을 제외한 음식과 음료는 실내에서 허용되지 않는다'고 명확히 말했습니다.
